title: Strict morphisms of fine saturated log schemes
statement: Let $f:(X,M_X)\to(Y,M_Y)$ be a morphism of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. It is strict when $M_X$ is the log structure associated to the inverse image of $M_Y$ via $f$. Equivalently, for every geometric point $t$ of $X$, the canonical map $\overline M_{Y,f(t)}\to\overline M_{X,t}$ on characteristic monoids is an isomorphism. The isomorphism must have the graph induced by the section maps of $f$, not be an arbitrary abstract isomorphism. Equivalently, in the compatible chart notation of [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale], every point of $X$ lies in a source chart neighborhood of a compatible chart square whose monoid homomorphism $P\to Q$ is an isomorphism; no smoothness or etaleness condition is placed on its comparison morphism. For an endomorphism, being the identity means being the identity on the underlying scheme and on all relative etale log sections.
